page.layout: One printed title page, centred block of lines; a woodcut ornament below the text; a faint show-through of the reverse page behind the title; a manuscript annotation at the right of the line "Tralatio." (not printed, so not transcribed).

main_text.l: Defenditur sacer Codex Ebraicus & B. Hieronymi Tralatio.

page.notes: The line "ad Joannem Calderwood, Bibliopolam" is set in the faint show-through from the reverse and is not clearly part of this title page; it is doubtful and may not belong to this page. The line between "adversus" and "ISAACUM VOSSIUM" is clear. The woodcut ornament is an engraving-like decoration with no text. Handwritten annotation "v. Athanasii Polyglott. T. III p. m. 45" at right is manuscript and omitted. Show-through text in the centre-left and right of the page is omitted.
